source.copyright_policy: Do not reproduce the transcript. Store extracted claims, hypotheses, and verification tasks only.

scope_policy.branch_guardrail: Scion Ascendant, Reliquarian, and Luminary must stay separate.
scope_policy.verification_gate: Any Luminary recommendation needs official/GGPK node names, mercenary skill data, gear restrictions, PoB support or documented PoB limitation, and at least one launch-week sample.

extracted_core_claims.summary: Luminary planning revolves around keeping permanent Mercenaries, with one active ally and reserves, instead of treating Mercenaries as temporary map helpers.
extracted_core_claims.modeling_impact: Build state must include active mercenary, reserve mercenaries, gear, role, skills, and survivability separate from player gem links.

extracted_core_claims.summary: The transcript stresses that permanent Mercenary access and major link/gear nodes compete for limited ascendancy points.
extracted_core_claims.modeling_impact: Luminary shells need point-budget variants rather than one all-in node list.

extracted_core_claims.summary: A key link-skill node is described as preventing the player from dying when the linked Mercenary dies.
extracted_core_claims.modeling_impact: Hardcore viability depends on whether the link-death drawback is reliably removed.

extracted_core_claims.summary: A Luminary node is described as converting light-radius increases/reductions into link-buff effect on Mercenaries.
extracted_core_claims.modeling_impact: Light radius becomes a possible link-effect scaling stat instead of a dead stat for this branch.

extracted_core_claims.summary: The transcript prioritizes a node where Mercenaries can equip unique weapons, shields, or quivers and gain more damage per unique equipped.
extracted_core_claims.modeling_impact: Mercenary gear planner needs unique-slot pressure, item access, and economy tags.

extracted_core_claims.summary: Hallowed Monarch is called out as a likely key item because linked skills can target damageable minions, linked minions take much less damage, and rare-kill modifiers can be gained by linked minions.
extracted_core_claims.modeling_impact: Treat Hallowed Monarch as a mandatory-watch item for Luminary link/minion/Mercenary shells.

practice_judgement.reason: The transcript creates strong hypotheses, but Luminary cannot be treated as a practice recommendation until node names, Mercenary skills, gear restrictions, item text, and PoB/live behavior are verified.
safe_practice_now: Learn generic Scion campaign routing only.
Review link skill mechanics and old item text without assuming 3.29 behavior.
Prepare test checklists for Mercenary gear, link uptime, and map survivability.
do_not_assume: Mercenary damage is free player DPS.
All link nodes fit in one ascendancy plan.
Hallowed Monarch is mandatory before launch economy data.
Spectre-style multi-link assumptions transfer to Mercenary builds.
